cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Today we're talking about SageMaker Model Cards.
cues.zh: 今天談 SageMaker Model Cards。

cues.en: Now, we're gonna start off quickly by covering open=source models because they are a great way for companies that are looking to build responsible AI
cues.zh: 先快速談開源模型，對想建立負責任 AI 的企業而言，

cues.en: to check a lot of those boxes.
cues.zh: 是滿足許多要求的好方式。

cues.en: Because open-source models are developed by communities, communities aim to make these models as responsible as as they possibly can.
cues.zh: 社群開發，努力讓模型盡可能負責任。

cues.en: They make them transparent, they make them as fair as they possibly can, and they check a lot of those boxes we talked about in responsible AI.
cues.zh: 提高透明、公平，符合先前許多原則。

cues.en: However, our organizations might not be extremely or fully satisfied with open-source models because they are safety concerns with open-source models
cues.zh: 但組織可能不完全滿意開源模型，因為有安全疑慮，

cues.en: because they are ultimately open-source.
cues.zh: 畢竟是開源。

cues.en: And also, that means they can't deliver proprietary, these proprietary models
cues.zh: 也不能因此得到只供組織使用的

cues.en: that they only can use in their organization.
cues.zh: 專有模型。

cues.en: So that's why model cards are a great alternative.
cues.zh: 所以模型卡是很好的替代。

cues.en: You're not going to be using open-source models that already have a lot of this documentation associated with them.
cues.zh: 如果不用已有大量相關文件的開源模型，

cues.en: Model cards help you document your models inside your organization.
cues.zh: 模型卡能協助記錄組織自己的模型。

cues.en: So here we've got SageMaker Model Cards, and what it offers, what this feature offers, three main things that you need to know for the exam.
cues.zh: SageMaker Model Cards 提供三個主要功能，考試要知道。

cues.en: The first one is documenting and tracking, which is things like the data sets that are used for building a certain model, the training, what happened during training, what didn't happen,
cues.zh: 第一記錄與追蹤，例如建模資料集、訓練過程發生與沒發生什麼，

cues.en: what went well, what didn't go well, performance, and lots of other things that are relating to actually development of a model.
cues.zh: 哪些順利、不順利、效能，以及開發相關事項。

cues.en: So it's very nice to have them, all those things in one place.
cues.zh: 集中一處非常好。

cues.en: Very good for auditing.
cues.zh: 方便稽核。

cues.en: So if somebody wants to check how is this model developed, does it follow AI, responsible AI principles, they can check all that documentation.
cues.zh: 有人想檢查開發過程、有無遵守負責任 AI 原則，就看文件。

cues.en: The second thing is in the model card, you can specify how it supports business goals and what is it meant to do in the business.
cues.zh: 第二，可說明如何支持業務目標、預計在企業做什麼。

cues.en: That's also very important to keep in mind as we discussed in responsible AI principles.
cues.zh: 也很重要，先前原則談過。

cues.en: One of them is robustness, to make sure the model is used for, is aligned with its intended use.
cues.zh: 例如穩健性，確保模型與預期用途一致。

cues.en: And you can also add user guides, and we don't mean, like, end-users or, like, your customers of your business, but the people inside your business who are going to be using this model,
cues.zh: 還能加使用指南，不是終端顧客，而是企業內會使用、

cues.en: deploying this model, or relying on this model.
cues.zh: 部署或依賴模型的人。

cues.en: You can add information on how they should be using it.
cues.zh: 提供如何使用的資訊。

cues.en: So those are three important things to remember about model cards, and as this topic might come up on your exam.
cues.zh: 三個重要項目，可能考。

cues.en: And also keep in mind about open-source models, the benefits and the disadvantages.
cues.zh: 也記住開源模型的優缺點。

cues.en: Here's a quick summary of what we discussed.
cues.zh: 快速整理。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing back to you next time, and until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 期待下次見，在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
